summary: BlackRock is american multinational investment management corporation, founded in 1988. Type: listed company. About 19,800 employees (Wikidata). Revenue $17.9 billion (2023). Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 1 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. News, last 3 months: 6 about funding; 7 about acquisitions; 3 about growth or hiring.

insights.one_liner: BlackRock is the US-based global asset manager, an IND visa sponsor with an entry-level finance job in Amsterdam that draws many applicants.

culture.text: About 34,724 people on LinkedIn; many studied finance, economics or computer science at schools like LSE, Columbia, Delhi University and University of Mumbai.
Has offices in more than 40 countries, working in business development, finance, engineering, IT and operations.
Its one open role here is an entry-level finance job in Amsterdam, averaging 200 LinkedIn applicants.

open.text: Recognised IND visa sponsor through BlackRock (Netherlands) B.V.
Its one open job here does not require Dutch.

growth.text: Staff grew from 11,400 in 2013 to 19,800 in 2023.
Revenue was $17.86 billion in 2023, with net profit of $5.502 billion.
Its infrastructure arm GIP is forming a fibre joint venture with AT&T and CPP Investments.

worth_knowing.text: BlackRock and Vanguard face growing pressure on fees as European banks launch their own ETFs.
Is moving full investment portfolios onto blockchain as part of a push into tokenisation.
